newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls 3.62 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls 3.62 pct.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index fell 3.62 percent in the week to Friday. The All Ordinaries Index fell 1.51 percent.
Mar 21 Mar 14 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

The Eyres Reed Explorers Index fell sharply this week, off 133.2 points, possibly signalling the end of the persistent and sometimes spectacular gains that have been recorded since mid to late 1996, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said.
Falls oustripped gains by three to one.

Of those that went against the trend, the best performers included Dalrymple Resources NL, up 5.0 cents to 46 cents, after a strong nickel show at its Lake Goongarrie joint venture with WMC Ltd. African explorer Tanganyika Gold NL improved 4.5 cents to 48 cents.
Copper hopeful Majestic Resources Ltd rose 2.0 cents to 24 cents after a large parcel of shares was transacted at 20 cents early in the week and Redfire Resources NL jumped 3.0 cents to 21 cents.

Falls were widspread. The largest included Golden Tiger Resources NL, off 15 cents to 60 cents, Finders Gold NL down 1.4 cents to 9.1 cents, Nugold Hill Mines NL off 4.0 cents to 16 cents, Diamin Resources NL down 7.0 cents to 43 cents and Equinox Resources NL down 10 cents to 64 cents.
